nodes.label: Flask.wsgi_app
nodes.desc: The real WSGI callable. try/finally guarantees ctx.pop even on unhandled errors.

nodes.label: Flask.handle_exception
nodes.desc: Converts unhandled exceptions into a 500 InternalServerError, honoring PROPAGATE_EXCEPTIONS.

nodes.label: Flask.request_context
nodes.desc: Creates the merged context from a WSGI environ.

nodes.label: AppContext.from_environ
nodes.desc: Builds app.request_class(environ) and passes it into the context.

nodes.label: AppContext.__init__
nodes.desc: Stores app, g, request; binds a URL adapter immediately, stashing HTTP failures as routing_exception.

nodes.label: Flask.create_url_adapter
nodes.desc: Binds url_map to the request (bind_to_request), honoring host/subdomain matching.

nodes.label: AppContext.push
nodes.desc: Sets _cv_app, sends appcontext_pushed, opens the session, then matches the URL.

nodes.label: AppContext.match_request
nodes.desc: url_adapter.match(return_rule=True) writes url_rule and view_args onto the request.

nodes.label: AppContext.pop
nodes.desc: Validates stack order, counts nested pushes, runs teardown, resets the contextvar.

nodes.label: _cv_app ContextVar
nodes.desc: ContextVar('flask.app_ctx') replaces the old thread-local stack since 3.2.

nodes.label: request LocalProxy
nodes.desc: Forwards attribute access to _cv_app.get().request; raises the classic working-outside-context error.

nodes.label: session LocalProxy
nodes.desc: Forwards to the context's session property, marking it accessed.

nodes.label: url_map
nodes.desc: Werkzeug Map created in the app constructor with host_matching option.

nodes.label: Flask.add_url_rule
nodes.desc: Builds a Rule, adds it to url_map, and maps endpoint -> view in view_functions.

nodes.label: Flask.register_blueprint
nodes.desc: Records options then hands off to blueprint.register.

nodes.label: Blueprint.register
nodes.desc: Builds a dotted name, rejects duplicates, registers a static route, replays deferred callbacks.

nodes.label: Blueprint.add_url_rule
nodes.desc: Captures the rule as a record callback deferred until register time.

nodes.label: Blueprint._merge_blueprint_funcs
nodes.desc: Copies blueprint-scoped hooks and view functions into app dicts under dotted keys.

nodes.label: Flask.full_dispatch_request
nodes.desc: Marks first request, sends request_started, chains preprocess -> dispatch -> finalize.

nodes.label: Flask.preprocess_request
nodes.desc: Iterates (None, *reversed(req.blueprints)) so innermost blueprint hooks run first.

nodes.label: Flask.dispatch_request
nodes.desc: Re-raises routing exceptions, answers automatic OPTIONS, else calls the endpoint.

nodes.label: view_functions
nodes.desc: Flat endpoint -> callable registry; duplicate endpoints raise AssertionError.

nodes.label: Flask.finalize_request
nodes.desc: make_response coerces the return value; process_response then fires finished signal.

nodes.label: Flask.handle_user_exception
nodes.desc: Looks up scoped error handlers for HTTPExceptions and user exceptions.

nodes.label: before_request_funcs
nodes.desc: defaultdict(list) keyed by blueprint scope (None = app-wide).

nodes.label: after_request_funcs
nodes.desc: Registered app- and blueprint-wide; executed in reverse registration order.

nodes.label: Flask.process_response
nodes.desc: Runs after_this_request first, then per-scope after_request_funcs, then saves the session.

nodes.label: after_this_request
nodes.desc: Appends to ctx._after_request_functions for the current request only.

nodes.label: session_interface
nodes.desc: Class attribute defaulting to SecureCookieSessionInterface(); swap it to change session backend.

nodes.label: AppContext._get_session
nodes.desc: Lazily opens the session on first access or push; falls back to make_null_session.

nodes.label: SecureCookieSessionInterface.open_session
nodes.desc: Unsigns the session cookie into a SecureCookieSession, or returns None.

nodes.label: SecureCookieSessionInterface.save_session
nodes.desc: Signs and writes the session cookie onto the response during process_response.

nodes.label: Flask.do_teardown_request
nodes.desc: Runs teardown_request funcs per blueprint scope (reversed), collecting rather than aborting on errors.

nodes.label: Flask.do_teardown_appcontext
nodes.desc: Runs teardown_appcontext funcs and the appcontext_tearing_down signal.
